policy.cohort: R11 Common8095 and Snow common two-character words
policy.wordBOrder: keytao: 21x21 first character then second; other domains second then first; sanpin: second then first
policy.ranking: frequency descending, text lexicographic; common cohort filtered before ranking as in frozen CKT
policy.sanpinStroke: all accepted first strokes; at B2 choose a first-choice code if available, then least upper CKT; optimistic bound
policy.selection: v2 scenario: native CKT with actual IVUAO keystroke costs + 500 ms*p2 + 100 ms*P(first auxiliary) + 150 ms*P(second auxiliary); three independent adjustable sliders, code lengths 2/3/4/5/6.

modelSource.extension: For the four nonnative keys, retain the frozen R11 cost increment relative to the strongest native donor; 5/6-key codes retain the frozen R11 long-code guard.

penaltyDefinition.normalization: Each of four groups divides by S005 at the same three penalties; fourth-power mean with character:word weights 1:2.
